summary: Frontend-only UI testing of QuickShare completed via the external URL. All 7 requested flows pass end-to-end: home page renders with branding and nav links, text share generates a 6-digit code with expiry countdown & copy button, file share tab switch + file input + generate button all work and returns a 6-digit code, text retrieve returns original text, file retrieve shows filename + working /download/<id> href, invalid code (000001) shows the error result banner with correct message, and short (<6 digit) codes trigger a toast without proceeding.
critical_code_review_comments: One benign console 404 was observed (likely a missing favicon or optional asset); does not affect functionality but consider adding /favicon.ico or a static reference.
seed_data_creation: Created two shares during test (text code + file code with temp file qs_ui_*.txt in /tmp). They expire in 10 min automatically.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend served through Node proxy on :3000 forwarding non-/api to Flask on :8001. All data-testid attributes present and reliable. Text tab is default on /share; File tab needs a click. share-code element contains the 6 digits (may have whitespace formatting - use regex to strip). Error message on invalid code appears in [data-testid=error-result] with text in [data-testid=error-text]. Short-code validation uses a toast (not the error-result element).
